definition.sextic_indices: Same primary Eisenstein primes and ordering as cubic; coefficients refer to omega=exp(2pi*i/3).
definition.sextic_symbol: zeta6=1+omega=exp(pi*i/3); reduce alpha=a+b*omega in F_p and identify alpha^((p-1)/6) with zeta6^k. Its square is the cubic character and its cube is the field quadratic character.
definition.sextic_null: Uniform sextic exponents on i<j, seed 0, with Cji=sij*Cij. sij is the product of the two field-quadratic characters of the opposite prime, so the exact full pairwise sign mask is retained. Diagonal zero.
definition.deflation: For arithmetic and control separately, remove every singular value s>2*sqrt(D); D remains the original dimension for the threshold.
definition.window: Sort remaining m singular values ascending. Take s[ceil(0.2*m):floor(0.8*m)] with Python exclusive upper endpoint.
definition.statistic: For consecutive gaps delta in that window, average min(delta_i,delta_(i+1))/max(delta_i,delta_(i+1)). A zero denominator contributes zero; no discarded ties; no unfolding.
definition.local_null: Same-D symmetry-matched exponent control, seed 0, same deflation and window rules.
definition.tolerances: Fixed finite-scale discrimination allowances; not calibrated confidence levels or asymptotic theorems.
definition.promotion: All four sextic comparisons must pass to mark RS-5 STRESSED for its tested sextic case. All four local comparisons must pass to mark RS-6 STRESSED for this statistic only; other universality assertions remain unverified.
definition.validation: Exact pure-Python sextic symbols/normalization/reciprocity; unchanged quad/cubic/quartic matrices byte-identical at X=20000 and top8 against SciPy at X=40000; sextic small matrix byte-exact against Python and top8 against SciPy before stress tests.

validation.classification: VALIDATION; sextic small-scale values are EXPLORATORY, not status drivers

execution_incidents.phase: checkpoint push after completed arithmetic spectrum
execution_incidents.reason: Concurrent documentation and results pushes briefly raced on the same branch ref; rejected push was retried serially. Arithmetic result c693bad was preserved, pushed, and the missing control resumed. No prediction, matrix or numerical algorithm changed.
